en: Exercise in the Ark's training area.

en: Complete an experiment by hand, without instructions.

zh: 读旧地球的资料
en: Read records from old Earth.

zh: 去方舟上没去过的地方逛逛
en: Visit parts of the Ark she has not been to.

zh: 照顾方舟培育舱里的植物
en: Tend the plants in the Ark's greenhouse.

zh: 给 ARK-01 做检查、上油
en: Inspect and oil ARK-01.

zh: 什么都不做
en: Do nothing at all.

zh: （临时）{girl}拆开又装好了一个小马达。
（临时）{girl}认真记下了土壤的颜色。
（临时）{girl}第一次把信号调清楚了。
（临时）{girl}在训练舱里跑得满头汗。
（临时）{girl}自己动手试了一个小实验。
（临时）{girl}读了一下午旧地球的资料。
（临时）{girl}在方舟上发现了一条没走过的走廊。
（临时）{girl}给培育舱里的苗浇了水。
（临时）{girl}给 ARK-01 仔细上了一遍油。
（临时）你们一起度过了开心的一天。
（临时）{girl}睡了个好觉。
（临时）{girl}累倒了，今天只能躺着休息。
（临时）{girl}说今天不想上课，躲进被子里不出来。
（临时）{girl}太累了，一直走神，只学会了一点点。
（临时小事件）上课时发生了一点小意外，{girl}冲你吐了吐舌头。

她把一个旧马达拆开又装回去，多出来一颗螺丝。
en: She took an old motor apart and put it back together. There was one screw left over.

zh: 她分不清哪把是十字螺丝刀，最后全试了一遍。
en: She couldn't tell which one was the Phillips screwdriver, so she tried them all.

zh: 她学会了用扳手，满屋子找东西拧。
en: She learned to use a wrench and went around the room looking for things to tighten.

zh: 她修好了床头那盏一闪一闪的小灯，开关了二十次。
en: She fixed the flickering lamp by her bed, then switched it on and off twenty times.

zh: 她画了一张马达的图纸，每个零件都标了名字。
en: She drew a diagram of a motor and labeled every part.

zh: 她拆开坏掉的计时器，找到了断掉的那根线。
en: She opened up a broken timer and found the snapped wire.

zh: 她把仙人掌浇得太多，土都泡软了。
en: She overwatered the cactus until the soil turned to mush.

zh: 她问你，为什么叶子不能是蓝色的。
en: She asked you why leaves can't be blue.

zh: 她在显微镜里看到会动的小东西，喊你快来看。
en: She saw tiny things wriggling under the microscope and called you over to look.

zh: 她记住了三种耐旱植物的名字，念了一整天。
en: She memorized the names of three drought-tolerant plants and recited them all day.

zh: 她看叶子的颜色，就猜出这盆草缺水了。
en: She could tell from the color of the leaves that the plant needed water.

zh: 她自己做了一张表，记下每盆植物多久浇一次水。
en: She made her own chart of how often each plant needs watering.

zh: 她对着对讲机喊了半天，才发现没开电源。
en: She shouted into the walkie-talkie for ages before realizing it wasn't switched on.

zh: 她把天线拧成了麻花。
en: She twisted the antenna into a pretzel.

zh: 她学会了用灯光打信号，对着窗外闪了好久。
en: She learned to signal with a flashlight and blinked it at the window for a long time.

zh: 她第一次自己调好频道，听到一片沙沙声。
en: She tuned a channel by herself for the first time and heard a wash of static.

zh: 她把摩斯电码背了下来，用敲桌子跟你"说话"。
en: She memorized Morse code and "talked" to you by tapping on the desk.

zh: 她从沙沙声里分辨出一段规律的信号，激动得跳起来。
en: She picked out a regular pattern in the static and jumped up in excitement.

zh: 她跑了两圈就坐在地上，说腿不是自己的了。
en: After two laps she sat on the floor and said her legs didn't belong to her anymore.

zh: 她不敢从跳箱上跳下来，最后是爬下来的。
en: She was too scared to jump off the vaulting box, so she climbed down.

zh: 她在走廊里跑了五圈，最后一圈是走完的。
en: She ran five laps of the corridor. She walked the last one.

zh: 她爬上了储物架，然后不敢下来了。
en: She climbed up the storage rack, then was too scared to come down.

zh: 她给自己定了个目标：跑十圈，一圈都没少。
en: She set herself a goal of ten laps and didn't skip a single one.

zh: 她从跳箱上跳下来，落地还摆了个姿势。
en: She jumped off the vaulting box and struck a pose on landing.

zh: 她做到一半就停下来，问你下一步该怎么办。
en: She stopped halfway and asked you what to do next.

zh: 她怕弄坏材料，一下午什么都没敢动。
en: Afraid of ruining the materials, she didn't dare touch anything all afternoon.

zh: 她做了个小风扇，转了三秒就冒烟了。
en: She built a little fan. It spun for three seconds, then started smoking.

zh: 她做的净水瓶滤出半杯水，骄傲地喝了一口。
en: Her water-filter bottle produced half a cup of water, and she proudly took a sip.

zh: 她失败了四次，第五次终于让小车跑了起来。
en: She failed four times, and on the fifth try her little car finally ran.

zh: 她没看说明书，自己想出了另一种接法。
en: Without reading the manual, she figured out a different way to wire it.

zh: 她翻了几页图鉴就睡着了，口水流在恐龙上。
en: She flipped through a few pages of the encyclopedia and fell asleep, drooling on a dinosaur.

zh: 她只看图，不看字。
en: She only looked at the pictures, not the words.

zh: 她读了旧地球的鸟类图鉴，问你有没有见过真的鸟。
en: She read a field guide to old Earth's birds and asked if you'd ever seen a real one.

zh: 她读到"下雨"，想知道雨打在脸上是什么感觉。
en: She read about "rain" and wondered what it feels like on your face.

zh: 她读到一座住满人的城市，问那些人后来去哪了。
en: She read about a city full of people and asked where they all went.

zh: 她把不认识的词都抄下来，一个一个查。
en: She copied down every word she didn't know and looked them up one by one.

zh: 她只在生活舱门口转了一圈就回来了。
en: She just walked around outside the living module and came right back.

zh: 走廊的灯太暗，她拉着门框不肯往前走。
en: The corridor lights were too dim, and she clung to the doorframe, refusing to go further.

zh: 她在观景窗前看了很久的地球。
en: She watched the Earth from the viewport for a long time.

zh: 她找到一间放满旧工具的储藏室，抱回来一把锤子。
en: She found a storeroom full of old tools and came back hugging a hammer.

zh: 她沿着一条没去过的走廊，走到了人类保护区的过道口。
en: She followed a corridor she'd never been down and reached the entrance to the Human Preserve.

zh: 她画了一张方舟的地图，还给每条走廊起了名字。
en: She drew a map of the Ark and gave every corridor a name.

zh: 她浇完水就跑了，忘了把喷壶放回去。
en: She ran off after watering and forgot to put the watering can back.

zh: 她嫌番茄苗长得太慢，戳了戳它。
en: Annoyed that the tomato seedling was growing too slowly, she poked it.

zh: 她给桌上的薄荷换了盆，弄得满手是土。
en: She repotted the mint on her desk and got dirt all over her hands.

zh: 她跟番茄苗说了一下午的话。
en: She spent the whole afternoon talking to the tomato seedling.

zh: 一片叶子黄了，她难过了好久，把它夹进了书里。
en: One leaf turned yellow. She was sad for a long time, and pressed it in a book.

zh: 她把最亮的那块地方让给了最小的那盆苗。
en: She gave the sunniest spot to the smallest seedling.

zh: 她把检查清单一口气点完，没仔细看。
en: She ticked through the whole checklist in one go without really looking.

zh: 她嫌 [阿克] 的履带太脏，不想碰。
en: She thought [阿克]'s treads were too dirty to touch.

zh: 她远程检查了 [阿克] 的履带，说它"有点累了"。
en: She checked [阿克]'s treads remotely and said it looked "a bit tired."

zh: 她给 [阿克] 的屏幕画了一个新表情。
en: She drew a new face for [阿克]'s screen.

zh: 她发现 [阿克] 有个关节响，记下来说下次一定修。
en: She noticed one of [阿克]'s joints was creaking and made a note to fix it next time.

zh: 她给 [阿克] 写了一张"保养日记"，还画了插图。
en: She wrote a "maintenance diary" for [阿克], complete with illustrations.

zh: 她一个人拼图，你问要不要帮忙，她摇了摇头。
en: She did a puzzle by herself. When you offered to help, she shook her head.

zh: 她讲故事讲到一半，说"算了，不好听"。
en: She stopped halfway through a story and said, "Never mind, it's not good."

zh: 你们一起拼完了一幅星图。她负责拼，你负责告诉她哪块放哪。
en: You finished a star-map puzzle together. She placed the pieces; you told her where they went.

zh: 她教你玩她自己发明的游戏，规则改了三次。
en: She taught you a game she invented and changed the rules three times.

zh: 她给你讲了一个自己编的故事，结局是你们一起去了地球。
en: She told you a story she made up. In the end, the two of you went to Earth together.

zh: 她把今天的事从早到晚讲了一遍，一件都没落下。
en: She told you everything that happened today, from morning to night, without leaving anything out.

zh: 她缩在床上，一下午没怎么说话。
en: She curled up in bed and barely spoke all afternoon.

zh: 她盯着天花板发呆，你叫她，她"嗯"了一声。
en: She stared blankly at the ceiling. When you called her, she just said "Mm."

zh: 她睡了个午觉，醒来心情很好。
en: She took a nap and woke up in a good mood.

zh: 她窝在床上看了一下午动画。
en: She snuggled up in bed and watched cartoons all afternoon.

zh: 她在床上打滚，唱了一首跑调的歌。
en: She rolled around on the bed singing an off-key song.

zh: 她睡醒以后，给桌上的薄荷也开了补光灯。
en: After waking up, she turned on the grow light for the mint on her desk too.

zh: 她上课时一直打哈欠，没记住多少。
en: She kept yawning through the lesson and didn't remember much.

zh: 她趴在桌上，笔在纸上画了一条长长的线。
en: She slumped over the desk, her pen trailing a long line across the paper.

zh: 她发烧了，今天只能躺着。你一直开着她床边的小灯。
en: She has a fever and has to stay in bed today. You kept the lamp by her bed on the whole time.

zh: 她病了，迷迷糊糊地喊你的名字，你一直应着。
en: She was sick and called your name in a daze. You answered every time.

zh: 她说今天不想上课，躲进被子里不出来。
en: She said she didn't want lessons today and hid under the covers.

zh: 她把课本推到一边："今天不要。"
en: She pushed her textbook aside. "Not today."

zh: 她对着电路图看了一节课，还是没找到问题在哪。
en: She stared at the circuit diagram the whole lesson and still couldn't find the problem.

zh: 她焊歪了两个接头，气得把焊枪放下了。
en: She botched two solder joints and put down the iron in frustration.

zh: 她把旧发电机的线圈重新绕了一遍，能转了。
en: She rewound the coil of an old generator, and it turned again.

zh: 她给自己做了一个工具架，每把扳手都有固定的位置。
en: She built herself a tool rack with a set place for every wrench.

zh: 她只听声音，就判断出是哪个轴承坏了。
en: She could tell which bearing had failed just by the sound.

zh: 她改装了一台旧水泵，效率比原来高了一截。
en: She modified an old water pump and made it noticeably more efficient.

zh: 她把两种土壤样本弄混了，只好重新取。
en: She mixed up two soil samples and had to collect them again.

zh: 她背了一节课的植物名，第二天忘了一半。
en: She spent the lesson memorizing plant names and forgot half of them the next day.

zh: 她测了一份土壤样本，写下了里面缺什么。
en: She tested a soil sample and noted what it was lacking.

zh: 她做了一个小温室模型，里面的湿度刚刚好。
en: She built a small model greenhouse with the humidity just right.

zh: 她设计了一套轮种方案，说小镇的地一年能种三茬。
en: She designed a crop rotation plan and said the town's land could yield three harvests a year.

zh: 她从叶片的斑点判断出是哪种病，配好了药。
en: She identified the disease from the spots on a leaf and prepared a treatment.

zh: 她调了一节课的频率，只收到自己的回声。
en: She spent the lesson adjusting frequencies and only picked up her own echo.

zh: 她搞错了信号的格式，发出去的全是乱码。
en: She got the signal format wrong, and everything she sent came out garbled.

zh: 她修好了一台旧收音机，里面传出一段很久以前的音乐。
en: She repaired an old radio, and music from long ago came out of it.

zh: 她学会了计算信号经过中继卫星要多久。
en: She learned to calculate how long a signal takes to pass through a relay satellite.

zh: 她自己设计了一种更省电的信号格式。
en: She designed her own, more power-efficient signal format.

zh: 她能从一段杂音里，把三个不同的信号分开。
en: She could separate three different signals out of a burst of noise.

zh: 她跑到一半就停下来，说今天状态不好。
en: She stopped halfway through her run and said she wasn't feeling it today.

zh: 她看着攀爬墙，最后选了旁边那条简单的路线。
en: She looked at the climbing wall and ended up choosing the easy route beside it.

zh: 她把跑步的成绩记在墙上，比上周快了几秒。
en: She wrote her running time on the wall. A few seconds faster than last week.

zh: 她爬到攀爬墙的顶上，往下看了一眼，又稳稳地下来了。
en: She climbed to the top of the wall, glanced down, and came back down steadily.

zh: 她选了最难的路线，一次就爬上去了。
en: She picked the hardest route and made it up on her first try.

zh: 她给自己加了负重，跑完还说"再来一组"。
en: She added weights, and after her run said, "One more set."

zh: 她把实验步骤抄了三遍，还是不敢开始。
en: She copied out the procedure three times and still didn't dare to start.

zh: 实验失败了，她把记录本合上，说不想做了。
en: The experiment failed. She closed her notebook and said she was done.

zh: 她做了一个小型净水装置，滤出来的水能喝。
en: She built a small water purifier, and the filtered water was drinkable.

zh: 她改了实验的方法，结果和书上写的不一样，她又做了一次确认。
en: She changed the method, got a result different from the textbook, and ran it again to confirm.

zh: 她做了一个书上没有的实验，还写了一份完整的报告。
en: She ran an experiment that isn't in any textbook and wrote a full report on it.

zh: 她把失败的数据也留了下来，说"这个也有用"。
en: She kept the data from her failed attempts too. "This is useful as well," she said.

zh: 她翻了几页，说这些旧东西跟现在没关系。
en: She flipped through a few pages and said this old stuff has nothing to do with now.

zh: 她读着读着就去看窗外了。
en: Partway through reading, she drifted off to look out the window.

zh: 她读了旧城市的规划图，对着小镇的地图比了半天。
en: She studied old city plans and spent ages comparing them with the town map.

zh: 她查到一种早就灭绝的鸟，把它的叫声放了好几遍。
en: She looked up a long-extinct bird and played its call over and over.

zh: 她发现两份档案里的日期对不上，把它们都标了出来。
en: She noticed the dates in two records didn't match and flagged them both.

zh: 她读到地下避难所的建造记录，问你那些避难所后来怎么样了。
en: She read construction records for underground shelters and asked you what became of them.

zh: 她去了几个常去的地方，没什么新发现。
en: She went to a few of her usual spots and found nothing new.

zh: 她说方舟早就逛遍了，没什么好看的。
en: She said she'd seen the whole Ark already and there was nothing left to see.

zh: 她在一间旧实验室里找到一本手写的笔记。
en: She found a handwritten notebook in an old lab.

zh: 她把小时候画的方舟地图找出来，补上了新发现的几条走廊。
en: She dug out the Ark map she drew as a kid and added the corridors she'd since discovered.

zh: 她在人类保护区的过道里站了很久，一个一个读休眠舱上的铭牌。
en: She stood in the Human Preserve corridor for a long time, reading the nameplates on the sleep pods one by one.

zh: 她在一间旧储藏室里找到一只拆下来的机械臂，型号和 [阿克] 身上的一样。
en: In an old storeroom she found a detached robotic arm, the same model as [阿克]'s.

zh: 她按清单浇完水，一句话也没说。
en: She watered everything on the list without saying a word.

zh: 她说植物又不会说话，照着做就行了。
en: She said plants can't talk anyway, so just follow the routine.

zh: 她把小镇那株植物的照片设成了屏幕背景。
en: She set a photo of the plant in the town as her screen background.

zh: 她给生活舱的每盆植物都挂了名牌。
en: She put a name tag on every plant in the living module.

zh: 一盆苗快不行了，她守了一晚上，第二天它又挺起来了。
en: A seedling was dying. She watched over it all night, and the next day it stood up again.

zh: 她说小镇的植物和这里的不一样，"它们是自己活下来的"。
en: She said the plants in the town are different from the ones here. "They survived on their own."

zh: 她快速跑完了 [阿克] 的检查程序，没看细节。
en: She rushed through [阿克]'s diagnostic routine without checking the details.

zh: 她说 [阿克] 只是一台机器，坏了就换零件。
en: She said [阿克] is just a machine. If something breaks, swap the part.

zh: 她给 [阿克] 换了一节新的履带，试了好几圈。
en: She replaced a section of [阿克]'s tread and test-drove it for several laps.

zh: 她把 [阿克] 这些年的维修记录整理成了一份文档。
en: She compiled [阿克]'s repair history over the years into a single document.

zh: 她翻出小时候给 [阿克] 画的屏幕表情，又装了回去。
en: She dug up the screen face she drew for [阿克] as a kid and installed it again.

zh: 她说 [阿克] 陪她这么多年，比谁都辛苦。
en: She said [阿克] has been with her all these years and has worked harder than anyone.

zh: 她戴着耳机做自己的事，偶尔"嗯"一声回应你。
en: She did her own thing with headphones on, now and then answering you with a "mm."

zh: 她说"我自己可以"，然后一个人待了一下午。
en: She said "I can manage on my own," and spent the afternoon alone.

zh: 你们一起整理了她小时候的画，她笑着说那时候画得好丑。
en: You sorted through her childhood drawings together. She laughed and said they were so ugly.

zh: 她拉你一起看了一部旧地球的电影，看完讨论了很久。
en: She got you to watch an old Earth movie with her, and you talked about it for a long time after.

zh: 她跟你说了一件一直没说出口的心事。
en: She told you something she'd been keeping to herself for a long time.

zh: 她靠在窗边跟你聊到很晚，说以后的事，也说小时候的事。
en: She leaned by the window and talked with you late into the night, about the future and about when she was little.

zh: 她把自己关在房间里，说想一个人待着。
en: She shut herself in her room and said she wanted to be alone.

zh: 她什么都没做，就那样坐了一下午。
en: She did nothing at all, just sat there all afternoon.

zh: 她睡了个懒觉，起来做了一顿早饭。
en: She slept in, then got up and made herself breakfast.

zh: 她窝在床上看了一整天的书。
en: She curled up in bed and read all day.

zh: 她一边哼歌一边收拾房间，把东西全都换了个位置。
en: She hummed while tidying her room and rearranged everything.

zh: 她泡了一杯热饮，在观景窗前坐了一下午，心情很好。
en: She made a hot drink and spent a happy afternoon sitting by the viewport.

zh: 她撑着上完了课，笔记写得歪歪扭扭。
en: She pushed through the lesson, her notes a crooked scrawl.

zh: 她说自己没事，可是一道题看了十分钟。
en: She said she was fine, but stared at a single problem for ten minutes.

zh: 她病倒了，烧得说不出话。你整夜开着床边的小灯。
en: She fell ill, too feverish to speak. You kept the bedside lamp on all night.

zh: 她病了，还想爬起来去看小镇，被你劝回了床上。
en: She was sick but still tried to get up and check on the town. You talked her back into bed.

zh: 她说今天不想上课，关上了房门。
en: She said she didn't want lessons today and shut her door.

zh: 她坐在课桌前，一页都没翻。"今天就算了吧。"
en: She sat at her desk without turning a single page. "Let's just skip today."
